dismissalText.commentary: Jason Roy not out 52 (43b 2x4 3x6 68m) SR: 120.93
Will Jacks c †Simpson b Carse 2 (5b 0x4 0x6 10m) SR: 40

dismissalComment.html: pace outside off, and nicked to the keeper! Test-match lines from Carse! Nipping off the seam at 86mph, a woolly whoosh of gloves, no footwork, and a simple edge!

dismissalText.long: c Brook b Mujeeb Ur Rahman
dismissalText.commentary: Sunil Narine c Brook b Mujeeb Ur Rahman 22 (11b 0x4 3x6 16m) SR: 200

dismissalComment.html: h-u-u-u-u-u-u-g-e hangtime from Narine, but he's right under the stroke! A crack of willow, fiercely flogged up through the full-length ball, but Brook saunters round at long-on to swallow the chance

dismissalText.commentary: Colin Ingram c Potts b Rashid 2 (4b 0x4 0x6 4m) SR: 50

dismissalComment.html: bit of width, outside off, slapped carelessly to deep cover! Sucker-ball from Rashid, a slider across the left-hander, drawing the stroke, on the up, and the sweeper is set back to swallow it! This is not going places yet for Invincibles

dismissalText.commentary: Sam Billings b Potts 3 (4b 0x4 0x6 7m) SR: 75

dismissalComment.html: bowled him! Billings makes room on the back foot, and manages only to clear a path for Potts to peg back the top of middle stump! Fast and straight, that'll do nicely!

dismissalText.commentary: Laurie Evans c Potts b Rashid 8 (9b 0x4 0x6 8m) SR: 88.88

dismissalComment.html: sweep, top-edged, straight to deep midwicket! This is a turkey shoot so far, Evans goes for power, but under-cuts his ambitious hoick across the line, a spiralling chance to Potts in the deep.

dismissalText.commentary: Jordan Clark c Vilas b Rashid 0 (1b 0x4 0x6 2m) SR: 0

dismissalComment.html: a slip in place and he's in the action straightaway! Dane Vilas, usually a keeper, reacts well to a fast-fizzing flash outside off ... one, two, three juggles, as the ball nestles in his hands as he falls backwards to deepen Invincibles' gloom

dismissalText.commentary: Adam Lyth c sub (JM Cox) b Curran 1 (4b 0x4 0x6 14m) SR: 25

dismissalComment.html: width on the full length, and slashed high to deep point! Oval spring the trap! There was no chance of getting the requisite power on that stroke, with protection set deep. That's a sucker punch

dismissalText.commentary: David Willey b Mahmood 4 (4b 0x4 0x6 4m) SR: 100

dismissalComment.html: bowled him! Exquisite line, shape back into the left-hander, extra lift too, Willey is cramped on the back foot and inside-edges into his bails! That's the way to get back into this game... wickets galore!

dismissalText.commentary: Harry Brook not out 47 (30b 5x4 1x6 55m) SR: 156.66
Dane Vilas c Curran b Mahmood 0 (1b 0x4 0x6 3m) SR: 0
